items.summary: Deplatforming by major payment processors poses a systemic risk to values-aligned and niche-market businesses. (NYSE: PSQH) (the "Company"), a payments infrastructure provider designed to assist businesses underserved by mainstream financial services companies, announced it successfully onboarded Dream Hunts, LandTrust's hunting experience business, after its payment processor shut off the account. The deplatforming left Dream Hunts temporarily unable to collect customer payments at the start of peak of the Spring hunting season. Dream Hunts operates independently from LandTrust's core land access marketplace.
